issues.description: Two huge visible stucco collider boxes (`obs_west_col` and `obs_east_col` at pos [-4.8, 3.5, 5.6] and [4.8, 3.5, 5.6]) protrude awkwardly out of the front of the round observatory drum, ruining the cylindrical architecture and looking like accidental grey blocks.
issues.fix: Keep all collider boxes strictly inside the cylinder radius (r = 8.6 centered at [0, y, -0.8]) so they never poke through the round drum wall, or integrate the front collider into the entrance portico volume.

issues.description: The observatory dome (`metal_light`) renders pitch black because pure metallic surfaces without environment reflections or roughness modulation appear black in this lighting setup, making the dome look like a flat black void.
issues.fix: Add architectural ribs (`trim` or `plaster_warm` torus/arches) over the dome surface or layer a slightly smaller/segmented dome with `plaster_warm` / `metal_light` panels and visible horizontal/vertical seam ribs so the dome catches sun light and reads as a bright metallic/architectural observatory dome.

issues.description: On the interior east and west walls, the large `screen` and `metal_dark` boxes at z = -1.2 (`pos: [-8.85, 2.2, -1.2]` and `[8.85, 2.2, -1.2]`) directly overlap and z-fight with the east and west windows (`center: -1.0, width: 2.6`).
issues.fix: Move the east and west wall chart screens along Z to `z = -3.8` (above the research desks) or `z = 2.0`, completely clear of the windows centered at `z = -1.0`.

issues.description: The secondary rooftop `telescope` prop (`pos: [3.2, 8.65, 5.8]`) is buried inside the dome / cornice geometry with only a tiny stick poking out.
issues.fix: Remove the buried rooftop `telescope` prop at `[3.2, 8.65, 5.8]` or place it on an actual accessible balcony/terrace outside the dome radius (e.g., on top of the front portico roof at `[0, 5.5, 7.2]`).

issues.description: The exterior `MARKET RESEARCH` sign has very low contrast and a bright point-light hotspot right below it, washing out the text.
issues.fix: Move the exterior point light slightly lower or further forward (`pos: [0, 3.2, 9.2]`, intensity `0.9`) so it doesn't bleach the sign face.

issues.description: The interior feels somewhat sparse around the perimeter and the central `table_round` (r=0.6) looks tiny on the 6.8m diameter star-map rug.
issues.fix: Build a larger custom round map table in the center (e.g. cylinder tabletop r = 1.35, h = 0.08 at y = 0.74 in `wood_dark` with a central pedestal and brass `trim` rim) with several market map `paper` planes, `books`, and `mug` on top, and add meeting chairs or a lounge/archive corner to make the room feel like a busy research observatory.

keep: Clear observatory silhouette with the cylindrical drum, upper window ring with vertical mullions, blue accent band, dome slit, and main telescope tube poking out.
Star-map circular rug with concentric border and constellation dots in the center of the interior.
Clean axial composition from the entrance looking across the central round map table to the telescope framed by the north window.
Celestial/market globe on a dark wood pedestal in the northeast corner.
